metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the linux-def:rpmverifypackage_test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the linux-def:rpmverifypackage_test.

notes.note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

criterion.comment: Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of equals.
Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of not equal.
Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of pattern match.
Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of equals and behaviors nodeps and noscripts are true.

rpmverifypackage_test.comment: Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of equals.
Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of not equal.
Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of pattern match.
Test that the rpmverifypackage_object is supported with the name operation of equals and behaviors nodeps and noscripts are true.

rpmverifypackage_object.comment: Retrieve package(s) with name operation of equals.
rpmverifypackage_object.name: rpm

rpmverifypackage_object.comment: Retrieve package(s) with name operation of not equal.
rpmverifypackage_object.name: rpm

rpmverifypackage_object.comment: Retrieve package(s) with name operation of pattern match.
rpmverifypackage_object.name: ^r[Pp]m$

rpmverifypackage_object.comment: Retrieve package(s) with the name operation of equals and behaviors nodeps and noscripts are true.
rpmverifypackage_object.name: rpm

rpmverifypackage_state.comment: Confirm correct item name, version, release, and arch.
rpmverifypackage_state.name: rpm

rpmverifypackage_state.comment: Confirm no item named 'rpm' is collected.
rpmverifypackage_state.name: ^audit

rpmverifypackage_state.comment: Confirm no item named 'rpm' is collected.
rpmverifypackage_state.name: ^audit
